name: Soot lantern
description: a flying iron lantern: a small soot-black iron lantern cage with a pointed cap, a pair of small leathery bat wings on its sides, one glowing ember eye behind its grille, short chains dangling below it; it floats in the air by itself

poses.stand: hovering on its little bat wings, the ember eye glowing
poses.struck: jolted sideways, its grille rattling, sparks flying off the iron
poses.dead: bursting apart into soot, iron scraps and embers

idle.action: hovers, wings flapping, swaying on its chains, the eye flickering

attack.action: its grille flares and it spits an ember forward to the right

hurt.action: is struck, jolts sideways and rattles on its chains, sparks fly off the iron, then it steadies

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers

style: Painterly digital painting in the style of dark fantasy video game art: soft visible brush strokes, rich shading, gritty and detailed, warm hellfire rim light, high resolution and smooth (not pixel art, not a cartoon).

prompts.standFromText: Paint {description}. Seen from the side, centered in the frame with lots of empty space around it, the whole thing visible. {style} {background}
prompts.pose: Image 1 is {description}. Show this exact same object, the same design, {action}. Keep its shape, colors, size and position in the frame and the painterly art style of image 1. {background}
